translations: The death of Sakura-umi, a beautiful actress
There are many rumors in the world
There's also a rumor that she was killed by someone
She was a different kind of person in the entertainment world, so...
It's just gossip... like a pillow, or a new recruit's seasoning
Honestly, you're not very popular, are you?
Your face and acting skills are certainly good, but...
I want to investigate the truth behind Sakura-umi's death
